QUOTE: approved = auto_approve_tools || is_explicitly_allowed(allow list)
       if !approved and on_tool_call != NULL → approved = true
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places the allow list in check_approval and says a match "skips the prompt", but it never says the allow list doesn't grant execution or that it is consulted only from check_approval in a different file. It also describes the allow list as feeding into ServerManager's PermissionManager.
